verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation and several ways to rework output without regenerating from scratch: a cheap 360p Draft Mode, Modify Video V2 for reshaping existing footage, and agents that 'generate, and refine.' However, the evidence never explicitly describes an iterate-on-a-generated-clip loop; extending or interpolating a prior video appears only as FAQ questions, and hands-on users struggled to reach demo-level results. missing for 10: explicit documentation of iterating on a prior text-to-video generation (extend/variation/edit-from-result), affirmative evidence for extend/interpolate, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful iteration workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time
